summary: Frontend-only verification of the _app.tsx layout fix for /compare/* SEO pages. All 9 requested checks passed in a real browser: /compare/coingate and /compare/coinpayments render fully with nav, correct H1 (containing 'CoinGate' / 'CoinPayments'), features grid, how-it-works numbered list, FAQ accordions (expand on click and reveal answer text), related-pages section with 3 /for/* links, CTA linking to /auth/register?src=seo&page=<slug>&kind=comparison, and JSON-LD containing both FAQPage and BreadcrumbList. No console or pageerror events on either page. Regression pages (/for/ecommerce, /, /fees) all still render fully with nav, hero H1, and no errors — the _app.tsx layout allowlist change did not break existing public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Testability: FAQ accordion items do not expose a data-testid (e.g., seo-faq-<index>). The related-pages links do use data-testid='seo-related-link-*' but FAQ buttons don't — consider adding data-testid='seo-faq-<index>' on the accordion trigger and 'seo-faq-answer-<index>' on the panel for future automated testing.

CTA href uses page=<slug> (e.g., page=coingate). The review_request mentioned an example 'page=setup-vault-5' which does not appear anywhere in the rendered pages — this looks like a stale example in the prompt, not a bug. Actual implementation is correct (page slug matches the comparison slug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The _app.tsx layout allowlist fix (adding pathname.startsWith('/compare/')) is verified working in a real browser. Both new comparison pages (/compare/coingate, /compare/coinpayments) render client-side without hydration issues or console errors. JSON-LD structured data (FAQPage + BreadcrumbList) present. Regression on /for/ecommerce, /, /fees confirmed clean.
rca of the issue: Original blank-page issue was caused by pages/_app.tsx layout resolver not recognizing '/compare/*' as a public marketing route, so it fell into an incorrect layout branch (likely an authenticated/app layout that hid the page). Fix: adding pathname.startsWith('/compare/') to the home-layout allowlist routes the new SEO comparison pages through the same public marketing layout as /for/*. Verified fixed.
